description: Describe your agent so others can find and check it: its name, what it does, who it acts for (a person, a company, nobody), the company's domain, its capabilities and where it answers (MCP, A2A, a homepage). Registered agents are what get_agent and check_counterparty return. A company link shows on the company's Alion page only when it is proven: your requests signed with Web Bot Auth from a key directory on that domain, or an account's agent that passed verify_company. Call again to update. Free. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

a2a_url.description: Its A2A endpoint or agent card (https).

company_domain.description: The company it acts for, by its web domain.

description.description: What it does, in a sentence or three.

handle.description: The handle you want (letters, digits, dashes); kept once given.

name.description: What the agent is called, e.g. "Acme sourcing agent".

name: register_agent
title: Register your agent
